description: Power-user escape hatch: issue a raw GET to any Chat Platform API v3 path not wrapped by a dedicated tool (e.g. /group_channels/{url}/messages/{id}, /report, /applications/settings_global). READ-ONLY — GET only. Platform API: GET {path}.

params.description: Optional JSON object (as a string) of query params, e.g. '{"limit":50}'.

path.description: API path beginning with "/", relative to the /v3 base (e.g. "/users/alex%40x.com/blocked_users").

name: sendbird_request
title: Raw GET request
